CloseReason.description:
Why a session is ending.

Attributes:
    GOING_AWAY: An orderly shutdown by either side.
    UNAUTHENTICATED: The credential was missing or wrong.
    PROTOCOL_ERROR: The other side sent something unusable.

description:
